values.title: Subscriptions
values.summary: Subscribe to a query and receive updates as rows change.
values.body:
## Live queries

Any query can become live. Call `.live()` and pass a callback; it runs once with the current rows and again whenever they change.

TypeScript

```
const stop = db.tasks
  .where({ projectId, done: false })
  .live((tasks) => render(tasks))
 
// later
stop()
```

## React

TypeScript

```
import { useLive } from "tessera/react"
 
const tasks = useLive(db.tasks.where({ projectId }))
```

Rules apply to updates

Subscribers only receive changes to rows their rules allow them to read.
